name: Jev Router
title: Jev Router: price, context window and specs
answer: Jev Router is a model from TypeSafe, first listed on 2026-09-25. It is the only version of its line in the catalog so far. It takes audio, file, image, text and video in and returns text, with a context window of 1 million tokens. The OpenRouter catalog lists it at no charge per token on at least one route. Its weights are not published, so it is reached through an API.
